tags.chapter_name: Classification of Elements and Periodicity in Properties

question.text: The element with <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">Z</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>120</mn></math> (not yet discovered) will be a/an

solution.text:
Og1188s2 is the configuration for Z=120.

Since the differentiating electron is entering in the s-orbital, the element will belong to the s-block and the outermost s-orbital is having two electrons. Hence, It will belong to the alkaline earth metal group.
